name: Model-Based Local Transfer Functions
definition: A visualization method for medical image volumes that applies multiple voxel-specific transfer functions simultaneously to different anatomical regions, determined by a deformable anatomical model registered to the volume.
summary: Model-Based Local Transfer Functions is a volume rendering method that assigns voxel-specific transfer functions based on a registered deformable anatomical model, adapting classification to patient anatomy rather than using global or purely spatial zones.
